name: High Bar Squat (Barbell)
instructions: Set up for the High Bar Squat (Barbell) with a barbell. Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your core braced.
Lower down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up, keeping your torso tall.
longevityNotes: Squatting is the foundation of getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs. Keeping leg strength and knee range preserves independence decades longer than any single other movement.
overview: High Bar Squat (Barbell) is a intermediate squat exercise for the quadriceps and glutes, performed with a barbell.
